resources.string: Zen settings are locked until %1$s. Allowing another language is a loosening and possible again afterwards.
At least one language must stay.

Videos whose title is clearly in a language not chosen above are not offered in the feed. Subscriptions, search and channel pages still show everything, and nothing is deleted. The recognition runs on this device from title and channel name (for opened videos also from the audio track or automatic captions); unclear titles always stay. Removing a language applies at once, allowing another one is a loosening (24 hours).
Last 7 days: first the videos kept out of the feed, then those that stay because the recognition is unsure.
No video of the last 7 days is kept out by language.
Language: %1$s? %2$s (%3$s) · unsure, stays in the feed
